LanguageData.RM_BurrowedInspect: Burrowed: sealed under the ash until the fire passes.
LanguageData.RM_FireFrontLetterText: A line of ember-grass has caught somewhere out in the open, and it is walking.\n\nThis is the biome, not an attack. It happens every few days here and it is why the old camps here pave a strip instead of raising a fence. Decide now whether it comes anywhere near you — a burn-line is far cheaper to steer than to stop.
LanguageData.RM_YesterdayFireMessage: Smoke to the {0}: yesterday's grass fire is still burning along the edge of its scar.
LanguageData.RM_BurnApproachLead: A burn line is {0} cells from your home, out to the {1}, and walking this way. It will be here in under a day.
LanguageData.RM_BurnApproachLeadEdge: A burn line has reached the edge of your home, on the {0} side.
LanguageData.RM_BurnApproachMessage: The burn is {0} cells from home, out to the {1}.
LanguageData.RM_BurnApproachMessageEdge: The burn has reached home, on the {0} side.
LanguageData.RM_ShovelSandDesc: Dig out loose sand for glass sand. The cell is shovelled down to what lies beneath (gravel), so a sand patch is a finite deposit. Done by miners.
LanguageData.RM_WetRootsInspect: Wet ash keeps its roots cool: grows as if {0} cooler (dry it would grow at {1}).
